mapper.select: SELECT sr.settlement_receipt_id, sr.uploaded_by_member_id, sr.settlement_id, sr.object_key, sr.content_type, sr.byte_size, sr.deleted_at FROM settlement_receipts sr JOIN settlements s ON s.settlement_id = sr.settlement_id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE sr.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND (s.created_by_member_id = #{memberId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement_members sm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sm.appointment_member_id WHERE sm.settlement_id = s.settlement_id AND am.member_id = #{memberId} AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL AND am.deleted_at IS NULL ))
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement_receipts SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE settlement_receipt_id = #{settlementReceiptId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
